//: W12 model registry. Model ids come from config/models.yaml's `executor` role (docs/STRATEGY.md §3, W12 row) — see output_apps/generated_modules/smartjudge/model_registry.py for the loader. Wired into .github/workflows/agent-task.yml via agent_runner.py's run_opencode(), which calls `opencode run --agent build --model <executor id>`. `ask` permissions are never used here: OpenCode runs non-interactively in CI (no terminal to answer a prompt), so an `ask` entry would hang until AGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_SECS kills the run. Every permission below is explicit allow or deny.
//providers: Keys come ONLY from the environment via {env:NAME} (see docs/ops/OPENCODE_KEYS.md); never write a key here. enabled_providers is a global allowlist (it cannot be set per agent): Groq returned 403 for the owner so it is excluded. The `free` agent is kept off customer data by its read-only tools plus its :free model id, not by this list. FREE-TIER PROVIDERS (mistral free Codestral tier, sambanova, omniroute scraped/free combos) are PUBLIC-CODE-ONLY: never send customer or case data to them (docs/factory/ROUTING.md). openrouter is the only paid, standard-data-policy provider here. sambanova model ids below were listed live by GET /v1/models on 2026-10-12 (they are provider ids, not config/models.yaml roles).; add a provider once a key is set. omniroute reads OMNIROUTE_API_KEY (the global ~/.config/opencode config uses the alias OMNIROUTE_OPENCODE_KEY; scripts/dev/rx and dispatch_opencode.sh export it from OMNIROUTE_API_KEY).

omniroute.name: OmniRoute (local gateway, scraped/free providers: PUBLIC CODE ONLY)

plan.description: Read-only: explore the repo and produce a plan. Never edits, never runs shell commands.

free.description: PUBLIC-CODE-ONLY free tier. Mechanical/non-sensitive chores only (formatting checks, doc typo scans, renaming). Read-only, same as `plan`. Must NEVER receive customer or case data: this model is config/models.yaml's `free` role, a non_sensitive_only, logs-or-trains-on-prompts provider (docs/STRATEGY.md §3b).

critical-reviewer.description: Read-only critical reviewer for diffs touching auth, tenancy (ownership/tenant checks in the repository layer), payments (Zibal) and SSRF (outbound URL fetches). Reports pass/fail per area; never modifies anything. No `model` key on purpose: the id comes from config/models.yaml's `reviewer` role (via model_registry.py) and is passed with `--model`, the same mechanism as the executor id.

build.description: Implements one GitHub-issue-labelled task in a worktree/branch (W10 phase 2, agent-task.yml). Runs non-interactively in CI: no `ask` permissions anywhere. Never pushes to main, never force-deletes, never touches secrets or the network directly.
